start.card:
Here are two chocolate bars, exactly the same size.
You can have 5/9 of Bar A or 4/7 of Bar B. A fraction like 5/9 means: cut the bar into 9 equal pieces and take 5 of them.
Which gives you more chocolate? Pick your guess below.
start.title: Chocolate bar fractions

afterGuess.card:
You guessed: 5/9 of Bar A. Let's check with the chocolate.
Press the buttons to cut Bar A into 9 equal pieces and Bar B into 7 equal pieces.
afterGuess.title: Chocolate bar fractions

after.card:
12/12 and 12/12 are the same amount: a whole bar. Move the sliders to try more.
Takeaway: bigger numbers don't mean more chocolate. The bottom number sets the piece size, so cut both bars into the same tiny pieces and count.
